items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: Cooney played nice piano himself. I think the both of them died.

ctx.x: Which one is Brunnell's brother Cooney? Cooney, Cooney.
That's right. Cooney played nice piano himself. I think the both of them died.
I know his brother, they call him Black Lester.
